'''2007 Dagobah Regionals Travis Cooper DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Travis Cooper]] at [[2007 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' The Last Charge of RalOps' Immortals
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
